# Versions of: The swarm, one real run at a time

1 published version of [The swarm, one real run at a time: the Web Summit demo that showed agents, the loops they start and the model calls they make, run for real, signed and replayed, step by step from one person and one agent to 24 loops at once, 216 model calls for 6.8 cents, the same work under a harness with 3 of 12 risky actions still possible instead of 11, and the Story Studio, where a spoken answer became a deck in front of you](../the-swarm-one-real-run-at-a-time.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out.
